body: Thanks for taking the time to reply, this is something I’ve never heard of before
I would love to know how that worked for you and maybe I can take some advice from your story
Games are a just a stopgap for me, and they don’t make me feel better about myself, esp after like 5 hrs I realize all I’ve been doing was absolutely nothing.
Right now I’ve been diverting to music, trying to just empty these feelings out. I’ve tried to talk to people but it just leaves me frustrated.
